decodeSwapResult.conclusion: With Windows-equivalent decoded pixels, the Linux environment reproduces the Windows run. The other environment differences (platform, Python, torch, harness hash, core count) had no observable effect in this controlled replay - not a general claim. Both decode paths remain experimental; neither is shown correct for HLG.
